SM_S3Take_PressurePlate.placement: Pivot centred on the walkable surface. Put Z at floor height, use NoCollision. Indicator lens faces +Y at (0, 78, -6).

SM_S3Take_CueLamp.placement: Floor pivot, 40 cm wide and ~83 cm tall, use NoCollision. Cyan runtime overlay can sit on the lens face, local (0, 16, 66), with 11 cm radius.

SM_S3Bridge_Platform.placement: 200 cm wide before edge details, deck top at Z=0, wheel bottoms at -57 cm. Use movable/blocking collision on a separate box covering the flat tread.

SM_S3Bridge_ProjectionScreen.placement: Pivot centre of the 720 × 224 cm usable canvas. Canvas faces +Y and ends at Y=4.2 cm. Put diagram on +Y=8 or closer.

SM_S3Bridge_SpliceDesk.placement: Ground pivot, facing +Y. Position behind the movement path so the controls stay visible.

SM_S3Bridge_FilmClip.placement: Moving clips. Home pivots at desk-relative X=-43/+43, Y=45, Z=72. Five positions are separated by 21 cm along Z.

SM_S3Bridge_Rail.placement: 240 cm repeat along X. Use NoCollision and place about 70 cm below the platform top, with scale adjusted to the section gaps.
